initial_application: The Jira comments record that the issue was effectively gone or hard to identify by August 2015, then Grahame Grieve removed one dangling reference in SVN revision 6606. No current Git commit explicitly mentions FHIR-8178, consistent with this being an old SVN-era DSTU1 cleanup.
additional_context: The current source/security-labels.html page contains security-label vocabulary and HCS guidance without web category, web categories, category tag, or old metadata-reference wording. Nearby source/security.html uses the current Resource Meta and Meta.security framing and links to the security labels page. Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later or conflicting community decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current built source already satisfies the issue by omitting the obsolete security-labels-page web-category reference and using current Meta.security guidance in the surrounding security documentation.
